_desc: Head-to-head LyDRL-DoD (faithful MADDPG repro of Zhong et al. IoT-J 2026) vs LyaMAPPO. n=5 eval seeds, T_EVAL=5400, lambda_high=4.0. MADDPG best checkpoint (min-DoD s.t. CR>=0.32, step 4000).
_takeaways: LyDRL-DoD achieves its objective: DoD 0.413 < LyaMAPPO 0.498 (a genuine, well-tuned DoD minimizer).
LyaMAPPO Pareto-dominates on everything that matters: satisfaction +89%, HL -50%, delay -45%, queue -43%.

Key paradox: LyDRL-DoD reaches LOWER DoD but 2x WORSE cumulative HL -> minimizing instantaneous DoD is a flawed proxy for battery lifetime; LyaMAPPO's HL-aware outcome-augmented design wins the real metric.
MADDPG (off-policy) showed pronounced regime instability during training (quick-eval CR swung 0.38<->0.79) vs MAPPO's stable convergence -- supporting the on-policy choice.
